canonical_edition: A. Bernabé (ed.), Poetarum epicorum Graecorum testimonia et fragmenta, pt.1 (Teubner, 1987), pp.137, 139–142: frr.1, 7–8; frr.7–8 = P.Ibscher, dubia.
sources_tested: Item-level Bernabé/P.Ibscher searches; Berliner Papyrusdatenbank P.18122 record and usage terms; local Pausanias TEI (tlg0525.tlg001.perseus-grc2) at 10.28.7; research literature/results distinguishing Minyas fr.7 from Hesiodic/Theseis attribution, checked 2026-08-12.
open_text_result: Pausanias 10.28.7 is an exact open Greek ancient testimony for the Minyas title (and the local text was checked), but the installed TEI has no explicit reuse licence. It does not supply the poetic P.Ibscher frr.7–8, which Bernabé deliberately labels dubia; therefore no complete licensed Greek text for this Canon selection is verified.
open_text_license: No explicit licence statement in the installed Perseus TEI; do not mark transferable pending licence verification.
scan_result: P.18122 (P.Ibscher) is an exact physical witness for Bernabé frr.7–8 and the Berlin record explicitly identifies both the disputed Minyas attribution and the Bernabé pages. Its official 600-dpi image endpoint is accessible, but the provider's usage terms say the presented images are for study and ‘sollen … nicht publiziert werden’; publication-ready images require timely request. It is consequently blocked for the HF public repository.
scan_rights: Berlin Papyrus Database usage terms: study access only; presented images must not be published, and publication requests are required. BLOCKED for public redistribution.
next_action: Retain the exact P.18122 record, direct 600-dpi endpoint and rights restriction in the scan queue but do not transfer.
